research_question: Discover authoritative broker, venue, or market-structure sources useful for mapping broker-supported CFD instruments to underlying session calendars, liquidity windows, contract specifications, and risk constraints for later MT5-equivalence checks; Stage-0 discovery only.

mt5_instrument_scope.allowed_scope: Any broker-supported FTMO/MT5 symbol with enough data and plausible mechanism; not crypto-only; prediction markets excluded.
mt5_instrument_scope.mt5_verified_requires: terminal-backed mt5_instrument_equivalence before any external/current data becomes MT5-bound

prior_failed_patterns: Do not use prediction markets or non-deployable instruments.
Do not treat name-similar external datasets as MT5-bound without explicit instrument-equivalence evidence.
prior_lessons: Phase 8A verified broad FTMO MT5 tradable universe; source discovery should be multi-asset, not crypto-only.
No WFA, MT5 terminal access, Phase 8E, trading, deployment, or promotion from Stage-0 requests.
